{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
*18 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] ground [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|chuck]]
*18 ounces ground [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|sirloin]]
*6 ounces garlic-flavored [[Cookbook:Crouton|croutons]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
*½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
*1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
*1 teaspoon dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], roughly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], peeled and broken 
*3 whole cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*½ red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]]
*1 ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
'''Glaze'''
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]]
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Tabasco Sauce|Tabasco]] or something that tastes like it
*1 tbsp blackstrap [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]

== Procedure ==
#Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 325 °F. 
#In a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] bowl, combine croutons, black pepper, cayenne pepper, chili powder, and thyme. Pulse until the mixture is of a fine texture. Place this mixture into a large bowl and set aside.
#Combine the onion, carrot, garlic, and red pepper in the food processor bowl. Pulse until the mixture is finely-chopped, but not pureed.
#Combine the vegetable mixture, ground sirloin, and ground chuck with the bread crumb mixture.
#Season the meat mixture with the salt, and add the egg.
#Combine thoroughly, but avoid squeezing the meat. 
#Pack this mixture into a 10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pan]] to mold the shape of the meatloaf. Onto a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]], turn the meatloaf out of the pan onto the center of the tray.
#Insert a temperature probe at a 45 degree angle into the top of the meatloaf. Avoid touching the bottom of the tray with the probe. Set the probe for 155°F.
#Combine the glaze ingredients. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the glaze onto the meatloaf after it has been cooking for about 10 minutes.
#Once the meatloaf has reached 155°F, take it out of the oven and let it sit for about 8–10 minutes before serving.

steps.text: Heat oven to 325 °F.
In a food processor bowl, combine croutons, black pepper, cayenne pepper, chili powder, and thyme. Pulse until the mixture is of a fine texture. Place this mixture into a large bowl and set aside.
Combine the onion, carrot, garlic, and red pepper in the food processor bowl. Pulse until the mixture is finely-chopped, but not pureed.
Combine the vegetable mixture, ground sirloin, and ground chuck with the bread crumb mixture.
Season the meat mixture with the salt, and add the egg.
Combine thoroughly, but avoid squeezing the meat.
Pack this mixture into a 10-inch loaf pan to mold the shape of the meatloaf. Onto a parchment paper-lined baking sheet, turn the meatloaf out of the pan onto the center of the tray.
Insert a temperature probe at a 45 degree angle into the top of the meatloaf. Avoid touching the bottom of the tray with the probe. Set the probe for 155°F.
Combine the glaze ingredients. Brush the glaze onto the meatloaf after it has been cooking for about 10 minutes.
Once the meatloaf has reached 155°F, take it out of the oven and let it sit for about 8–10 minutes before serving.
